# Vendored LeRobot source — the version openpi pins (openpi column)

- Repo: https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot
- Commit: `0cf864870cf29f4738d3ade893e6fd13fbd7cdb5` (committed 2025-05-28)
- Why this commit: openpi `215abfb` pins it in `pyproject.toml:70` (see `../openpi_215abfb/`),
  so this is the LeRobot code an openpi user runs, not LeRobot main.
- Fetched: 2026-10-02
- `CODEBASE_VERSION = "v2.1"` (`lerobot_common_datasets_lerobot_dataset.py:77`)

Filenames are the repo path with `/` replaced by `_`. Do not edit; re-pin when openpi moves
its pin.

License: LeRobot is Apache License 2.0; a copy is in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). The files here are
unmodified copies, kept so that every citation in this project can be checked offline.
